concepts.statement_en: Executive Order 51, the Philippine Milk Code of 1986: advertising milk formula or milk substitutes inside health facilities is prohibited, health facilities/workers may not accept money or gifts from milk companies in exchange for promoting their products, and BHWs are expected to promote breastfeeding to mothers in the community instead.
concepts.source: deck slide 21; facilitator-guide PDF 22; reference-manual PDF 14

concepts.statement_en: Republic Act 10028, the Expanded Breastfeeding Promotion Act of 2009: all workplaces, including health facilities like health centers and barangay health stations, are required to promote breastfeeding and to have lactation stations.
concepts.source: deck slide 22; facilitator-guide PDF 22; reference-manual PDF 14

concepts.statement_en: DOH Administrative Order 2015-0053: promotion, sponsorship, and other marketing activities by pharmaceutical companies are prohibited inside health facilities, and health workers themselves may not promote any medicine or curative product, so that a company cannot influence how the health center treats or serves people.
concepts.source: deck slide 23; facilitator-guide PDF 22; reference-manual PDF 14

concepts.statement_en: DOH Department Circular 2021-0486: health facilities are directed to phase out single-use plastics starting 2022 — including thin plastic cups, drinking straws, coffee stirrers, plastic cutlery, and plastic bags — to reduce waste that causes pollution, illness, and disaster.
concepts.source: deck slide 24; facilitator-guide PDF 22; reference-manual PDF 14

concepts.statement_en: Beyond the four named policies, this competency also covers workplace best practices, workplace policies, efficient resource utilization (e.g. saving electricity or water), resourcefulness, and workplace productivity.

Module 3 maps to the TESDA BHS NC II competency 'Practice entrepreneurial skills in the workplace', whose outcomes are: apply entrepreneurial workplace best practices, communicate entrepreneurial workplace best practices, and implement cost-effective operations.
